name: indent
note: css-text-3 §2.2 first-line indentation: the default indents only the first formatted line (20px), hanging indents every line except the first, each-line indents the first line and every line after a forced break, and a 10% indent resolves against the containing block width (200px → 20px). The second lines' x positions are pinned by the rect layer through the overflowing-line geometry and the screenshot band.
